finding.title: Preliminary diagnostic directory marker write precedes strict junction validation
finding.counterexample: A Windows junction in an output ancestor redirects root/junction/newreports outside intended path. ensure_output_dir(mark=True) can mkdir/write marker because safe_fs only checks is_symlink; strict write_diagnostic _safe detects junction afterward, too late to prevent preliminary side effect.
finding.minimal_correction: Remove preliminary ensure_output_dir/mark writes from startup diagnostic adapters. Pass the original Path output to write_diagnostic, whose strict _safe validates run component and every existing ancestor before its own safe directory creation. Preserve typed original errors if diagnostic storage fails.
